mapper.select: WITH open_elig_ria AS ( SELECT * FROM nyehms_ria_doc WHERE complete_date IS NULL AND Nvl(ria_eligible, 'N') != 'N' and MERGED_RIA_STATENO IS NULL and nvl(STATENO_DELETED, 'N') != 'Y' ), vl_labs AS ( SELECT eligRia.document_id RIA_DOCUMENT_ID, 'VL' LAB_DOCUMENT_TYPE, p.stateno , eligRia.lab_doc_id DOCUMENT_ID , s.interpret_cd, c.interpret_cd_group, s.calc_collection_date, s.FNAME, s.LNAME, s.DOB_TEXT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.stateno ORDER BY s.calc_collection_date DESC) vlrn FROM person_doc_association p, std_hiv_eclrs_doc s, coded_interpret_code_group c, open_elig_ria eligRia WHERE eligRia.curr_nyehms_stateno = p.stateno AND p.document_id = s.document_id AND p.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND s.interpret_cd = c.interpret_cd AND c.test_type_cd = 'VL' ) SELECT STATENO "stateno", RIA_DOCUMENT_ID, LAB_DOCUMENT_TYPE "documentType", TO_CHAR(DOCUMENT_ID) "documentId", INTERPRET_CD, INTERPRET_CD_GROUP, TO_CHAR(CALC_COLLECTION_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') COLLECTION_DATE, FNAME, LNAME, DOB_TEXT FROM vl_labs WHERE vlrn = 1 AND interpret_cd_group = 'NDVL'

SELECT r.document_id "documentId", TO_CHAR(r.mshcreateDate, 'MM/DD/YYYY') "receivedDate", to_char(r.obxnote) "obxNote" FROM std_hiv_eclrs_doc a JOIN person_doc_association b ON b.document_id = a.document_id AND b.dissassociation_date IS NULL JOIN raw_hiv_eclrs_doc r ON r.document_id = a.document_id WHERE Trim(a.test_result) LIKE '<%' AND Trim(a.test_result) != '<0' AND Trunc(a.calc_collection_date) > Trunc(sysdate) - 30 AND (a.prov_county not in ('005','047','061','081','085','999','998') OR a.facility_county not in ('005','047','061','081','085','999','998')) AND b.stateno = #{p_stateno}
